subject: maths
title: Shapes, Direction and Movement - Faces, Corners and Turns

steps.title: Shapes keep their names

options.label: One triangle has turned upside down. Are both still triangles?
These are the cube's flat faces shown separately. How many faces?
The robot faces up, then turns right without moving. Where does it face?

steps.hint: Compare sides and corners, not the direction the point faces.
steps.explanation: Notice unchanged shapes, all six cube faces and a robot turn.
steps.shortExplanation: Make, count or compare the objects. Explain what changed.

mathWorkshop.title: Shapes keep their names
mathWorkshop.goal: Notice unchanged shapes, all six cube faces and a robot turn.

tasks.prompt: One triangle has turned upside down. Are both still triangles?
tasks.feedback: Both still have three straight sides and three corners. Turning keeps the shape unchanged.
tasks.hint: Compare sides and corners, not the direction the point faces.

tasks.prompt: These are the cube's flat faces shown separately. How many faces?
tasks.feedback: A cube has six square faces. A single view of the cube hides some of them.
tasks.hint: Count all six named face pictures once, including the hidden back and bottom.

tasks.prompt: The robot faces up, then turns right without moving. Where does it face?
tasks.feedback: It faces right. Turning changes facing, while staying in the same place.
tasks.hint: The robot stays on its square. Imagine a right turn from up.

parentReview.en: Guided practice is ungraded. Completion records the child doing the activities, not a book-question score.

steps.title: Maths discovery 2
steps.prompt: How many faces does a cube have?
steps.hint: Turning leaves the shape the same. Count each face or corner once.

steps.title: Maths discovery 3
steps.prompt: How many corners does a cube have?
steps.hint: Turning leaves the shape the same. Count each face or corner once.

steps.title: Maths discovery 4
steps.hint: Turning leaves the shape the same. Count each face or corner once.
steps.explanation: Both are triangles. Turning does not change the shape.
steps.shortExplanation: Both are triangles. Turning does not change the shape.

source.answerKeyText: Yes — both are triangles; one is just turned.

steps.title: Maths discovery 5
steps.prompt: How many flat faces does a cylinder have?
steps.hint: Turning leaves the shape the same. Count each face or corner once.
steps.explanation: A cylinder has two flat circular faces.
steps.shortExplanation: A cylinder has two flat circular faces.

steps.title: Maths discovery 6
steps.prompt: sphere, cube, cube, sphere, cube, cube... What comes next?
steps.hint: Turning leaves the shape the same. Count each face or corner once.
steps.explanation: The repeating part is sphere, cube, cube.
steps.shortExplanation: The repeating part is sphere, cube, cube.

steps.title: Try it at home
steps.prompt: With an adult, name something in a playground that has the shape of a circle.
steps.hint: Turning leaves the shape the same. Count each face or corner once.
steps.explanation: Try it with an adult. Talk about what you found.
steps.shortExplanation: Try it with an adult. Talk about what you found.

source.answerKeyText: Any circle: a wheel, a swing seat top, the top of a bin, a clock.

parentReview.en: Any circle: a wheel, a swing seat top, the top of a bin, a clock.
parentReview.note: Discuss with an adult; this personal or drawing response is not automatically graded.

steps.title: Maths discovery 8
steps.prompt: Sort the solid shapes by their faces.
steps.hint: Turning leaves the shape the same. Count each face or corner once.
steps.explanation: Sphere, cylinder and cone have curved faces; the other shapes have only flat faces.
steps.shortExplanation: Sphere, cylinder and cone have curved faces; the other shapes have only flat faces.

source.answerKeyText: curved: sphere, cylinder, cone • only flat: cube, cuboid, pyramid

steps.title: Maths discovery 9
steps.prompt: The robot faces up. Choose both routes that reach the star two spaces up and two right.

options.label: turn right, 2 forwards, turn left, 2 forwards

steps.hint: Turning leaves the shape the same. Count each face or corner once.
steps.explanation: Both selected routes finish two spaces up and two right of the start.
steps.shortExplanation: Both selected routes finish two spaces up and two right of the start.

source.answerKeyText:
2 forwards, turn right, 2 forwards. (Also correct: turn right, 2 forwards, turn left, 2
forwards.)

steps.title: Maths discovery 10
steps.prompt: A shape that is turned round...
steps.hint: Turning leaves the shape the same. Count each face or corner once.
steps.explanation: Keeps its name is the answer. Its sides and corners stay the same.
steps.shortExplanation: Keeps its name is the answer. Its sides and corners stay the same.

steps.title: Maths discovery 11
steps.hint: Turning leaves the shape the same. Count each face or corner once.
steps.explanation: 1 pointy corner is the answer. A cone meets at one pointed corner.
steps.shortExplanation: 1 pointy corner is the answer. A cone meets at one pointed corner.

steps.title: Maths discovery 12
steps.hint: Turning leaves the shape the same. Count each face or corner once.
steps.explanation: One curved face is the answer. A sphere is curved all around.
steps.shortExplanation: One curved face is the answer. A sphere is curved all around.

steps.title: Maths discovery 13
steps.hint: Turning leaves the shape the same. Count each face or corner once.
steps.explanation: 6 faces is the answer. A cuboid has six flat faces.
steps.shortExplanation: 6 faces is the answer. A cuboid has six flat faces.

steps.title: Maths discovery 14
steps.hint: Turning leaves the shape the same. Count each face or corner once.
steps.explanation: 3 sides is the answer. A triangle has three straight sides.
steps.shortExplanation: 3 sides is the answer. A triangle has three straight sides.

stickers.meaning: A flat or curved part of a solid shape.

homeActivities.text: Feel safe solid shapes in a bag and describe flat or curved faces. Mark each cube corner once. Give robot commands along a paper grid.
homeActivities.textAr: حطّوا مجسمات آمنة في شنطة، وخلّوا الطفل يحسّسها من غير ما يشوف ويوصف وشوشها: مسطحة ولا مقوّسة. علّموا كل ركن في المكعب مرة واحدة. وادّوا أوامر للروبوت على شبكة مرسومة على ورقة.
homeActivities.safety: An adult supervises. Keep small objects away from younger children. An adult handles scissors. Use water at the sink, away from electrical items.
homeActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. خلّي الحاجات الصغيرة بعيد عن الأطفال الأصغر، والكبير يمسك المقص. أنشطة المية تكون عند الحوض وبعيد عن الكهرباء.
